div.head: Iud Dei XIV 5
div.ab: Alia oratio. Deprecor te, Domine sancte, Pater omnipotens, aeterne Deus, qui cęlum formasti et terram fundasti, mare limitibus terminasti, solem et lunam in splendore lucere fecisti, ut intelligant astantes, quia tu es (Deus), qui facis mirabilia.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 425 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: from Bb; omitted in the others

div.ab: Another prayer. I beseech you, holy Lord, Father almighty, eternal God, who formed the heaven and founded the earth, bounded the sea with limits, made the sun and moon shine in splendour, that those standing by may understand that you are (God), who do wonders.
